mapper.select: SELECT rc.*, r.name AS road_name, a.area_name AS area_name, ps.name AS plan_status_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name) AS users_name_str, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tools_name_str FROM road_cleaning rc LEFT JOIN sys_road r ON rc.road_id = r.sys_road_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON rc.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON rc.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, rc.staff_ids) AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_tool t ON FIND_IN_SET(t.sys_tool_id, rc.tool_ids) AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE rc.deleted = 0 GROUP BY rc.id, r.name, a.area_name, ps.name ORDER BY rc.id DESC

SELECT rc.*, r.name AS road_name, a.area_name AS area_name, ps.name AS plan_status_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name) AS users_name_str, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tools_name_str FROM road_cleaning rc LEFT JOIN sys_road r ON rc.road_id = r.sys_road_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON rc.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON rc.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, rc.staff_ids) AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_tool t ON FIND_IN_SET(t.sys_tool_id, rc.tool_ids) AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE rc.deleted = 0 GROUP BY rc.id, r.name, a.area_name, ps.name ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
